# Contract: scripted-screencast

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Scripted browser actions rendered into a demo video with cursor motion, zoom, captions and optional vertical output. A browser-page recorder, not a desktop recorder.

## Use it for
- "record a product demo of my web app"
- "re-render the walkthrough after the UI change"

## Not for
- record my whole desktop or a native app (not supported)
- a looping animation (code-loop)

## Accepted inputs
A local web app or file and a demo script (demo.mjs or .json).

## Deliverables
preview/final mp4, optional 9:16, stills, failed-step screenshots.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Opens only the URL in the script; use local apps and fictional data.

## Cost-sensitive operations
Local rendering time only.

## Workflow
1. Stage the app first
2. Write the script
3. Preview
4. Final
5. Report

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Staged data and fictional brand
- Approve the preview

## Quality checks
- Preview stills inspected
- Paths with spaces, Unicode and drive letters resolve to valid file URLs

## Common failures
- Selector drift after UI changes (error names the step and saves a screenshot)
- Real credentials typed into a site (forbidden)

## Limitations
- Browser pages only
- Mobile gestures are simulated with mouse events

## Reproducible example
examples/tidy-demo.mjs from a folder whose path contains spaces and Unicode (evidence/scripted-screencast).
